selection.ownership: Moonshot Ventures, Inc., Abbotsford, Canada. Reviewed edition is the hosted Basin API at usebasin.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Basin API v1 Authorization Token header, GET /api/v1/projects as cheap authenticated read, forms and submissions list, Moonshot Ventures Inc. Canada identity, Slack marketplace listing (Canada / AWS + DigitalOcean), and dated incident search for Basin / usebasin.com / Moonshot Ventures security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Distinct from Basin Harbor Resort, Beanstalk Basin protocol, and Dark Basin. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

domains.list.description: List custom sending domains for the authenticated Basin account via GET /api/v1/domains. Maps to BASIN_GET_DOMAINS.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Composio documents this as starting at 0.

query.description: Filter domains by ID or name.

domains.list.title: List domains

form_views.list.description: List legacy Form Builder (Form.io) views via GET /api/v1/form_views. Maps to BASIN_LIST_FORM_VIEWS.

query.description: Filter form views by id, uuid, form id, or form uuid.

form_views.list.title: List form views

form_webhooks.create.description: Create a form webhook via POST /api/v1/form_webhooks/. Maps to BASIN_CREATE_FORM_WEBHOOK. Basin wraps attributes under form_webhook.

form_id.description: ID of the form this webhook is attached to.

format.description: Payload format. Official values include json, slack, and form_url_encoded; omit for default JSON.

trigger_when_spam.description: If true, fire this webhook even when a submission is flagged as spam.

url.description: Destination URL where Basin will POST the submission payload.

form_webhooks.create.title: Create form webhook

form_webhooks.delete.description: Delete a form webhook via DELETE /api/v1/form_webhooks/{webhook_id}. Maps to BASIN_DELETE_WEBHOOK.

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook to delete.

form_webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook

form_webhooks.get.description: Retrieve one form webhook via GET /api/v1/form_webhooks/{id}. Maps to BASIN_GET_FORM_WEBHOOK.

id.description: ID of the form webhook to retrieve.

form_webhooks.get.title: Get form webhook

form_webhooks.list.description: List form webhooks via GET /api/v1/form_webhooks. Maps to BASIN_GET_WEBHOOKS. form_id is required by Composio and is sent as a query filter.

form_id.description: ID of the form whose webhooks should be listed.

query.description: Filter webhooks by name, id, url, or form_id.

form_webhooks.list.title: List form webhooks

form_webhooks.update.description: Update a form webhook via PUT /api/v1/form_webhooks/{webhook_id}. Maps to BASIN_UPDATE_WEBHOOK. Basin wraps attributes under form_webhook.

form_id.description: ID of the form this webhook is attached to.

format.description: Payload format. Official values include json, slack, and form_url_encoded; omit for default JSON.

trigger_when_spam.description: If true, fire this webhook even when a submission is flagged as spam.

url.description: Destination URL where Basin will POST the submission payload.

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook to update.

form_webhooks.update.title: Update webhook

forms.create.description: Create a form under a project via POST /api/v1/forms/. Maps to BASIN_CREATE_FORM. Basin wraps attributes under form. Official writable fields are accepted (Composio's nested notifications/spam_settings objects are the same Basin attributes, flattened).

allowed_domains.description: Domains allowed to submit the form.

auto_response_mail_template_id.description: ID of the auto-response mail template.

autoreply.description: Whether to send auto-reply emails to submitters.

autoreply_custom_template.description: Custom HTML template for auto-reply emails.

autoreply_email.description: Email address to send auto-replies from.

autoreply_name.description: Name shown as sender in auto-reply emails.

autoreply_use_custom_template.description: Whether to use a custom auto-reply template.

blocked_domains.description: Domains blocked from submitting the form.

confirmation_mail_template_id.description: ID of the confirmation mail template.

content_blacklist.description: Content patterns to block in submissions.

contribute_to_spam_training.description: Whether submissions contribute to spam training.

custom_template.description: Custom HTML template for notification emails.

data_receipt_email.description: Whether to send data receipt emails.

domain_id.description: ID of the custom sending domain.

exclude_submitter_from_reply.description: Whether to exclude the submitter from reply emails.

force_recaptcha.description: Whether to require Google reCAPTCHA verification.

force_turnstile.description: Whether to require Cloudflare Turnstile verification.

hide_dashboard_button.description: Whether to hide the dashboard button on the success page.

honeypot_field.description: Name of the honeypot field used to trap spam bots.

logo.description: URL of the logo image for the form.

notification_emails.description: Comma-separated notification recipients. Empty string clears recipients.

notification_mail_template_id.description: ID of the notification mail template.

notification_subject.description: Custom subject line for notification emails.

project_id.description: ID of the project this form belongs to.

recaptcha_failed_url.description: URL to redirect to when reCAPTCHA verification fails.

redirect_button_text.description: Button text on the redirect page.

redirect_heading.description: Heading text for the redirect page.

redirect_message.description: Message text for the redirect page.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain form submissions.

smtp_email_validation.description: Whether to validate email addresses via SMTP.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for form timestamps.

use_ajax.description: Whether the form should submit via AJAX.

use_custom_template.description: Whether to use a custom notification template.
